action.mutates: creates /srv/p8test-logs (owner syslog, rsyslogd's runtime user), adds /etc/rsyslog.d/99-p8test.conf routing the tag p8test to /srv/p8test-logs/p8test.log, restarts rsyslog, sends one message with logger -t p8test (rsyslog logs its restart to /var/log/syslog)

creates /srv/p8test-other (owner syslog), adds /etc/rsyslog.d/98-p8test-other.conf routing the tag p8testother to /srv/p8test-other/p8test.log, restarts rsyslog, sends one message with logger -t p8testother (the kernel logs the AppArmor denial to the journal and /var/log/kern.log; rsyslog logs its restart to /var/log/syslog)
